the-lives-of-the-twelve-caesars-volume-0: No emperor is more infamous than Nero, and this ancient biography is where much of the legend began. Suetonius recounts the great fire of Rome, the persecution of Christians, and the emperor's extravagant performances on stage — true or exaggerated, it shaped how the world remembers him. A vivid, gossipy account of power curdling into cruelty and farce.
